premises: Aging at ~550–580°C induces nanoscale L12 precipitates in the fcc lamellae of AlCoCrFeNi-based eutectic HEAs
These L12 precipitates are coherent and provide precipitation strengthening via the Orowan mechanism
The precipitation strengthening significantly increases yield strength without harming ductility
The L12 precipitates improve corrosion resistance by stabilizing dislocation channels
The same precipitation behavior and benefits observed in Al0.7CoCrFeNi will transfer to AlCoCrFeNi2.1
